Info

Defines structural runtime-checkable protocol IPrimitiveCompiler for processing primitive DSL instructions.

class scarajectory.core.service.dsl.compiler.iprimitive_compiler.IPrimitiveCompiler(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural protocol defining contracts for primitive instruction compilation.

It defines:

methods:
can_compile - Checks if compiler handles given instruction command type.
compile - Compiles instruction, updating context and accumulator waypoints.
can_compile(*, instruction: IScaraInstruction) → bool[source]¶

Determines whether this sub-compiler handles the specified instruction.

Parameters:

instruction – Primitive AST instruction node.

Returns:

True if this compiler handles the instruction, False otherwise.

compile(*, instruction: IScaraInstruction, context: ScaraCompilerContext, waypoints: list[Waypoint]) → None[source]¶

Processes the instruction, updating compiler state context or appending waypoints.

Parameters:

  • instruction – Primitive AST instruction node.

  • context – Mutable compiler execution context.

  • waypoints – Accumulator list of compiled Waypoint instances.
